Every entry below was checked against its primary source (the paper, the publisher's or
proceedings record, or the official course page) before it was listed. The workshop cites
specific sections, equations or theorems; the repository's `references.bib` records, for
each entry, what was opened and which location we rely on. Facts we could not verify are
listed in [`OPEN_QUESTIONS.md`](https://github.com/project-delphi/practical-rl/blob/main/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md)
and are not used on the site.

Module pages group their own further reading, with which sections to read and why.
